description: This file defines the DBManagerFactory class, which is responsible for instantiating and configuring database manager objects based on type and configuration. It includes methods to get database instances, disconnect all connections, and locate database driver classes.

classes.name: DBManagerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing database connection objects based on configuration and type, supporting different database drivers.

methods.name: getTypeInstance
methods.description: Returns a DBManager object of a specific type, initializing and requiring the proper driver file if necessary.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides and returns a singleton database manager instance, optionally by a specific instance name.

methods.name: disconnectAll
methods.description: Disconnects all active database connections managed by this factory.

methods.name: getManagerByType
methods.description: Returns the class name of a database driver for a given type if available.

methods.name: scanDriverDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for valid database driver classes and adds them to the provided drivers array.

methods.name: _compareDrivers
methods.description: Compares two drivers by their priority for sorting purposes.

methods.name: getDbDrivers
methods.description: Returns a list of available database drivers, optionally validating their compatibility.

methods.name: isFreeTDS
methods.description: Checks whether the FreeTDS driver is installed, used for MSSQL connections.
